{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()

# Filter for completed orders
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders, excluding QA orders
mean_revenue = completed_df[~qa_mask]['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print results
print(f"QA orders found: {qa_count}")
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue:.2f} USD")"}
